summary.intent: Complete the final 3 gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) of a v1.1 milestone using the GSD manager loop — discuss, plan, and execute all three phases sequentially.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 was fully completed (8 plans executed across 3 waves, code reviewed, verified against live DB, marked complete). Phase 43 was discussed, planned (4 plans), and Wave 1 execution completed (plan 43-01 merged). Phase 44 was discussed and context written but not yet planned or executed.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) had no ownership check — JwtAuthGuard only, handler never reads req.user, passes any CID string straight to Kubo pin/rm. Any JWT holder can destroy another user's pinned content.

Kubo runs with the 'server' profile (disables LAN discovery only) but swarm port 4001 is publicly exposed — the node still participates in the public DHT and broadcasts provider records for every pinned CID, making CIDs publicly discoverable by crawlers.

Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without calling unpin (shared-write.ts:450) — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists anywhere in the codebase, making any cross-user unpin definitively malicious or a race.

pnpm --filter <pkg> test -- --testPathPattern=X is broken: pnpm inserts its own '--' separator before the user's '--', causing jest to treat --testPathPattern as a positional regex argument. Must use: pnpm --filter <pkg> exec jest --testPathPattern='X'

gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' as a false negative even when the commit lands. Always verify with git log after any commit helper call; never blind-retry based on the helper's return value.
No .prettierignore existed in the repo, causing prettier to mangle .planning/ markdown documents and GSD-controlled files on every format pass.
The upload compensation path in ipfs.controller.ts fires a global pin/rm on a CID that could be content-address-deduped with another user's content — a secondary cross-tenant unpin surface.

Postgres advisory xact lock on hashtext(cid) is the correct concurrency primitive for the delete+refcount+outbox transaction — closes the double-concurrent-unpin race that would strand orphaned Kubo pins.
BYO-IPFS unpin is broken in both directions today: the controller ignores provider abstraction for unpin, and advisory rows for BYO vaults would need the same guardedUnpin path to count correctly.

code.finding: Kubo v0.40 uses 'server' profile but swarm port 4001 is exposed publicly (tcp+udp). Server profile only disables local-network discovery; public DHT participation and provider record broadcasting remain fully active.

Upload compensation path fires a global pin/rm directly — this CID may be content-address-deduped with another user's vault blob, creating a cross-tenant unpin surface beyond just the /unpin endpoint.
guardedUnpin implemented with pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) wrapping the row-delete + refcount + pending_unpins outbox insert in one transaction. Kubo pin/rm fires post-commit best-effort.

Drain worker calls provider.unpin (not raw Kubo) and error-isolates per row. Drift report (runDriftReport) is read-only — zero .delete( calls in the drift path, preventing accidental GC of valid pins.

WriteQueue fully rewritten with JournalOp, JournalEntryStatus, JournalEntry. Provides put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay. fsync barrier before ack is the core durability guarantee.

workflow: Worktree cleanup helper (cleanup-wave) must be run from the repo root — it resolves repoRoot from cwd, so running it from inside an agent worktree produces false base_mismatch errors on every entry.

cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun and abort the whole run. Write reduced manifests containing only remaining (not-yet-merged) entries when retrying.
Worktree cruft (node_modules, .husky/_) must be removed before cleanup-wave runs — the helper cannot merge a worktree with untracked large directories.
When git auto-resolves all merge conflicts but the commit step fails, MERGE_HEAD is left behind. Conclude with 'git commit --no-edit' rather than re-running the merge.

nest build can produce formatting-only drift in openapi.json as a side effect even when no API schema changed. Restore with 'git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json' before merging worktrees.

1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git Bash tool calls. Signing failures ('agent returned an error') require the user to restart the 1Password desktop app — retrying the same command rarely recovers without that.
Decision coverage gates use literal citation grep (e.g., 'D-07:') — plans must include a must_haves truth line with the exact decision ID string or the gate fails mechanically.

Phase branches (feat/*) are auto-managed by GSD; main is never touched. When rebasing a later phase's context commits onto a completed earlier phase branch, git rebase drops duplicate STATE.md timestamp-bump commits cleanly.
zsh multi-glob rm (rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules) aborts entirely if any glob misses a path — use single explicit paths for each directory to be removed.
RAM constraint: never run full monorepo test suites in subagents or post-merge gates. Always target specific packages with --filter and specific test path patterns.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures blocked commits multiple times, requiring user to restart the 1Password app before retrying. No programmatic recovery path exists.
gsd commit helper false negatives ('committed: false') caused unnecessary uncertainty and retry attempts on commits that had already landed successfully.
Prettier had no ignore file, silently mangling .planning/ docs on every format pass. Discovered only when a regex pipe in VALIDATION.md was split into a table column by prettier.
cleanup-wave not idempotent + cwd-sensitive: two separate bugs that compound — running from wrong cwd poisons results, and retrying after partial merge requires manually crafting reduced manifests.
42-05 worktree merge left MERGE_HEAD after conflict auto-resolution succeeded but commit step failed — required manual 'git commit --no-edit' to conclude.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build polluted the main worktree and had to be detected and restored before the Wave 3 merge to avoid a spurious diff.
pnpm --filter test -- --testPathPattern broken by pnpm's argument insertion. Discovered mid-session when targeted post-merge gates failed with unexpected jest behavior.
Planner agent hit a socket error after writing plans 01-03 for Phase 42, requiring filesystem inspection and a continuation planner spawn for the remaining 5 plans.
Session context limit was hit mid-session twice (once during discuss, once during code review), requiring conversation continuation and re-orientation.
Accidental user input ('touring wyatt web bossy') caused two tool-use interruptions during wave execution, requiring the user to explicitly resume.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed because the plan used descriptive prose without the literal 'D-07:' citation string that the gate's grep pattern requires.
